bodyMarkdown:
## Engineering Manager Salary: What You Need to Know

If you’re negotiating an engineering manager salary or evaluating a job offer, understanding how hourly rates translate to annual pay is essential. In Australia, most engineering managers are covered by the Professional Employees Award 2020, which sets minimum rates for professional staff. However, actual salaries often exceed award minima, especially for experienced managers.

### The Basic Conversion Formula

To convert an hourly rate to an annual salary, use this formula:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

We assume a standard full-time week of 38 hours, as defined in the Professional Employees Award and the National Employment Standards. For example, if you earn $50 per hour:

$50 × 38 × 52 = $98,800 per year

This gives you a gross annual figure before tax and super. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, and no penalty rates or allowances. For a fortnightly view, multiply the weekly amount by two: $1,900 per week becomes $3,800 per fortnight.

### National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. This is the legal floor for award-free employees. However, engineering managers are almost always covered by the Professional Employees Award, which has higher minimum rates.

The award classifies professionals into levels. For instance:

- Level 1 Graduate (3-year degree): $33.71 per hour ($66,825 per year)
- Level 2 Experienced professional: $39.77 per hour ($78,836 per year)
- Level 3 Professional/senior: $43.46 per hour ($86,157 per year)
- Level 4 Professional/experienced: $49.02 per hour ($97,173 per year)
- Level 5 Experienced medical research employee: $59.05 per hour ($117,064 per year)

An engineering manager salary typically falls at Level 3 or above, depending on experience and responsibility. The award minimum for Level 4 is $97,173 per year, but many engineering managers earn well above that in the market. The Australian Bureau of Statistics reports that full-time adult average weekly ordinary time earnings were $2,083.70 per week in May 2026, which equates to about $108,352 per year. Engineering managers often exceed this average.

### Casual Loading and Part-Time Work

If you work as a casual engineering manager, you are entitled to a 25% loading on top of the minimum hourly rate. For example, a casual Level 3 professional would earn $43.46 × 1.25 = $54.33 per hour. This loading compensates for not receiving paid leave or other entitlements. The [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) page explains how to calculate it.

Part-time employees are paid pro-rata based on their agreed hours, using the same hourly rate as full-time employees.

### Superannuation Is Paid on Top

Your employer must contribute superannuation at 12% of your ordinary earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. This is paid in addition to your salary. So if your annual engineering manager salary is $120,000, your employer adds $14,400 to your super fund. The [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) guide has more details.

### Tax on Your Engineering Manager Salary

For the 2026–27 financial year, resident tax rates are:

- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15% of excess over $18,200
- $45,001 – $135,000: $4,020 plus 30% of excess over $45,000
- $135,001 – $190,000: $31,020 plus 37% of excess over $135,000
- $190,001+: $51,420 plus 45% of excess over $190,000

Plus a Medicare levy of 2% (with reductions for low-income earners). Use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator to estimate your net income.

### Using the Pay Guides and Reference Tables

For precise award rates, always refer to the Fair Work Ombudsman’s [pay guides](/blog) and the [reference tables](/data) on this site. The award rates are updated annually on 1 July. Remember that your actual engineering manager salary may be negotiated above the award minimum, especially if you have specialised skills or manage a team.

### Summary

- Convert hourly to annual: hourly × 38 × 52.
- The National Minimum Wage is $26.44/hour; award rates for engineering managers start around $43.46/hour.
- Casual loading adds 25%.
- Super is 12% on top, capped at $270,830.
- Tax is progressive with a tax-free threshold.

Always check your specific award classification and any enterprise agreement that may apply. For a quick estimate, use the [timesheet](/) tool on this site.
